name: Barquisimeto
registryBasis: Barquisimeto is the municipal seat of Iribarren, and the Municipality’s SEMAT portal directs residents to register urban properties for municipal taxation. The municipal notice states this tax registration is distinct from issuing a cadastral certificate, which is a function of the Municipal Cadastre Directorate. The public routes reviewed are account/form based and request taxpayer/property documents; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was found.

officialSources.observation: SEMAT identifies itself as the Alcaldía de Iribarren; the public portal has registration and login flows. No account was created and no user or property data was submitted.

SEMAT’s municipal notice for property registration without a cadastral certificate says tax registration is exclusively for tax purposes and does not issue or renew a cadastral certificate; that is handled by the Municipal Cadastre Directorate. The form instructions request taxpayer identity and property documents; no form was submitted.
The Municipal Comptroller of Iribarren’s official site is local-government context and links to SEMAT.
The municipal catastro ordinance PDF under the Municipal Comptroller site was not fetchable during review, so no exact coverage or public map schema is inferred from it.
